result.title: DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited
result.comment: 35 pages including appendices. Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/DOPER/ Code: https://github.com/NVlabs/DOPER
result.summary: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.

AI.brief_summary: DOPER 是一个仅用 RGB 的 6D 物体位姿估计框架，共享视觉骨干联合做检测、分割与关键点预测，再经 PnP 求位姿，并借助合成到真实的适配、多视角几何约束与对关键点分布的刚性拟合来消歧。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接交集，但其「不学习额外精修器、直接把几何刚性约束拟合到预测的关键点分布上以消解对应歧义」的做法，可能为多假设视觉证据的聚合与几何一致性检验提供可核查的借鉴。
